messages:
sam: Noticed a weird packing spike in prod-eu-west1 — a lot of tiny inference pods are stuck Pending and warm pools aren't absorbing them. Seen this for ~40m now.
maria: Grafana dashboards show `gpu.pending.count` up to 95 and `warmpool.active_util` down. Strange signal: nodes with free fractional capacity are idle while pending queue grows.
kai: did we flip the binpack/coalescing flag in the scheduler rollout? I deployed the tighter packing heuristic last week. Could be rejecting fractional overlap.
sam: I checked the scheduler-config map; `allow_fractional_coalesce` is false after the rollout. We used to co-locate 0.25/0.5 requests. Now pods require a full slot unless they land on an explicit tiny-pool node.
maria: kubectl snippet (truncated):
```
# kubectl get pods -n prod | grep Pending
inference-batch-77    Pending   0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient gpu
tiny-serve-21         Pending   0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match node selector
```
jun: autoscaler logs show it attempted scale up at 1799612000 but cloud returned `ResourceQuotaExceeded` for GPUs in eu-west1 (limit=8, requested=12). We also hit spot-supply failures twice.
nana: I mean ana: quota ticket CLOUD-9278 is open. Ops told me region quota is on a hard cap until end of billing cycle.
kai: two immediate mitigations: 1) temporarily re-enable fractional coalescing in scheduler (safer: only for tiny workloads) 2) send fallback routing to eu-west2 or hosted fallback if eu-west1 quota rejects.
sam: I'm nervous about cross-region fallback — that will introduce higher latency for latency-sensitive traffic. But for background rerank jobs it's fine. We should classify pods by `latency_class`.
maria: quick patch I applied to one deployment to test coalescing (example):
```
kubectl patch deploy tiny-serve -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"scheduler.alpha/coalesce":"true"}}}}}'
```
infra-bot: ALERT: [gpu-pending-pods] cluster-prod-eu-west1 threshold breached (count=95) at 1799612100
ops-bot: Scale attempt by provisioner returned ResourceQuotaExceeded at 1799612135. Request rejected for 4 gpus.
jun: after applying coalesce annotation to a few tiny deployments pending dropped to ~22 within 8 minutes. Warmpool util rose from 18% -> 49%. Patch looks effective.
nana: opened INFRA-2057 to track: revert scheduler rollout until coalescing safe flag is added + add canary for scheduler toggles. Added runbook snippet and who-to-ping (cloud-ops, infra-scheduler).
kai: long-term: - add region-fallback policy with latency class mapping - autoscaler should attempt a partial fallback (spin small pool in neighboring region) before pod eviction; - create a quota slack monitor to preemptively request bumps.
maria: also add a preflight check in rollout job: if pending_gpu_count > 10 for 15m, block scheduler config changes.
sam: for now i'll roll the scheduler flag back to allow_fractional_coalesce=true for tiny workloads only and watch cost. I'll coordinate with cloud-ops on CLOUD-9278.
jun: status at 1799612589: pending=9, warmpool util=52%. Leaving alerts on but removing paging.
kai: thanks team — please paste the INFRA-2057 link here when it's ready and add the rollout gate to the CI job. I'll follow up in the weekly ops sync. :thumbsup:
